newsitem.title: DENMARK: Carlsberg denies Egyptian project report.
newsitem.headline: Carlsberg denies Egyptian project report.

text.p: Danish brewery giant Carlsberg A/S denied on Monday media reports that it signed a deal with U.S.Luxor investment group to participate in a brewery project in Egypt with local Al Ahram Beverages Company (ABC).

"Carlsberg has made no deal with Luxor Group on building a brewery or making a licensing deal for our beer in Egypt with ABC. We have only approved that Luxor in their prospectus mentions such a project as a possibility," Carlsberg information chief Monica Ritterband told Reuters.
Ritterband declined to make any further comment.
U.S. Luxor Group acquired last year a 75 percent holding in ABC, Egypt's sole brewer.
